desc: Ideate solution approaches and select reverse order-statistic selection.

Implement a complete Python program that reads N and P from stdin, uses a Fenwick tree initialized with 1 in all N positions, processes i from N down to 1 to find the P_i-th available position, assigns ans[position] = i, updates that position to 0, and prints the final array as space-separated integers.
Verify 1-based indexing, k-th order statistic logic, and edge cases such as P_i = 1 and P_i = i.
Test against the provided samples and ensure performance is acceptable for N = 500000.
